quotes.text: NS_ENSURE_ARG_POINTER() isn't quite right here, since it's not an argument. NS_ENSURE_STATE() might be more appropriate.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Use NS_ENSURE_STATE for invalid internal object state; reserve argument guards for caller-provided arguments. D210737 changed the guard for member m_mailDB from NS_ENSURE_ARG_POINTER to NS_ENSURE_STATE after an inline request. The macro communicates the error contract, not merely a null check. Scope to these Mozilla guard macros and inspect the appropriate return behavior at the call site.
title: Use C++ guard macros that describe the source of the precondition
